name: ViscribeAI
description: ViscribeAI is a cutting-edge AI tool designed to enhance transcription and note-taking processes. Leveraging advanced machine learning algorithms, it provides accurate and efficient transcription services, making it ideal for professionals and businesses seeking to streamline their documentation tasks.

events.n: Ask a Question About An Image
events.d: Get a clear answer to a specific question about an image.
Classify an image based on general knowledge or predefined classes.
Compare two images and return a clear summary of their similarities and differences.
Generate a short, plain‑language description and optional tags for an image provided as a URL or base64 string.
Extract specified text or numeric fields from an image (URL or base64) and return them as structured data.
